column1: # Reviewed Spanish definitions (words.gloss_es) of the commonest words.
# For any other word the pipeline takes Wikcionario's first current
# Peninsular sense (src/definiciones.rs), which is often not the everyday
# meaning ("coche": a horse carriage), and Wikcionario changes every week.
# Every word of the reviewed range has a row, so a new Wikcionario download
# lemma<TAB>definition, one word per line, in rank order at the time of the
# review. The definition is shown exactly as written here: no full stop at
# the end, at most 101 characters, no wiki markup, and never the word it
# defines (it is the prompt of rounds whose answer is that word).
# "-" as the definition means the word gets no Spanish definition; the app
# About three in five definitions are copied from Wikcionario
# (es.wiktionary.org) contributors via kaikki.org, CC BY-SA 4.0; the others
# were written for this app where Wikcionario's wording was too technical,
# cut short or about another sense. This file is shared under CC BY-SA 4.0.
